title: Cottage Cheese Egg Bowl
subtitle: 10 min breakfast bowl. No cooking.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Anchor or Meadow Fresh tub at Tops/Villa dairy aisle. Mainland is the cleanest macros.

ingredients.note: Cook all 4 the night before — keeps 3 days fridge in shells.
Oil cap. For drizzling — not for cooking.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Dill is rare in Thai supermarkets — Villa carries it. Chives (the Thai 'kuichai') are easier.
Tops sells the McCormick jar. Or DIY: sesame seeds + poppy + dried onion + garlic + salt.

substitutions.note: Tangier, smoother. Drop ~50 kcal. Loses the curd texture.
Brunch upgrade. Norwegian smoked salmon at Tops. Higher protein, higher sodium.

steps.text: If eggs aren't already cooked: 7-min soft boil from boiling water. Ice bath 1 min. Peel.
Tip cottage cheese into a wide bowl. Smooth it out — don't pile.
Halve the eggs lengthwise. Lay yolk-up around the cottage cheese.
Tuck tomato and cucumber slices in the gaps.
Drizzle 1 tsp olive oil over the cottage cheese only (not the eggs).
Shower everything-bagel, pepper, flaky salt. Herbs over the top.

notes: The breakfast that out-protein-densities everything else by sheer ingredient choice. 57g protein, no cooking required (if eggs were batched). Cottage cheese is the cheat code — Thai supermarkets carry it now (didn't 5 years ago). Buy 2% not full-fat unless the macros need padding.
